story.originalTitle: F1 driver contracts: How long is each driver tied down for?
story.summaryEn: This article outlines the believed contract lengths of each F1 driver and analyzes possible future driver moves and their timing. Among them, McLaren driver Lando Norris recently announced a new four-year contract with the team, believed to run until 2030.
detailZh: F1车手合同：每位车手被绑定多久？
以下是每位F1车手目前的合同期限以及何时到期
F1车手合同的具体条款属于高度保密信息，但合同年限往往会对外公布。
以下是每位F1车手据信签订的合同期限，据此分析未来可能出现的车手变动及其时间点。
这位卫冕F1世界冠军近期宣布与迈凯伦签下一份新的四年合同，将至少效力至2030年。据信合同中还包含可进一步延长该合同的条款。
诺里斯于2017年作为青训车手加入迈凯伦，2019年晋升至F1车队，并于2025年成为世界冠军。
2025年初，奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里与迈凯伦签下新合同，效力至2028年底。
这位澳大利亚车手在经历了国际汽联合同认证委员会就阿尔派与迈凯伦之间纠纷的听证后，于2023年加入迈凯伦完成F1首秀。
尽管梅赛德斯此前曾追求马克斯·维斯塔潘，乔治·拉塞尔对自己的队内位置一直充满信心，其合同已经落实。这位英国车手签约至2027赛季末。
拉塞尔在威廉姆斯实际上租借效力三个赛季后，于2022年加入梅赛德斯，他于2019年在威廉姆斯完成F1首秀。
基米·安东内利据信与梅赛德斯的合同也持续至2027年底。
这位意大利车手在刘易斯·汉密尔顿2025年转投法拉利后，接替了其在梅赛德斯车手阵容中的位置。
马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队，洛朗·梅基斯，红牛车队领队
马克斯·维斯塔潘与红牛在2026年荷兰大奖赛宣布新合同，至少持续至2030年底。
维斯塔潘于2014年成为红牛青训车手，2015年以17岁之龄在姊妹车队红牛二队完成F1首秀，并于2016赛季中期被提拔至红牛车队。
伊萨克·哈贾尔的合同将于2027年底到期，他于2026年从小红牛加入红牛一队。
这位法国车手于2025年代表小红牛完成F1首秀，立即令人印象深刻，在荷兰大奖赛登上领奖台，并因此在2026年迅速晋升至红牛。
法拉利通常不愿透露其车手合同年限的细节，但各方均已确认合同至少持续至2027年——这意味着，加上合同条款，他在2025年加盟时签下的是一份三年合同。
汉密尔顿于2007年代表迈凯伦完成F1首秀，2008年赢得首个世界冠军，之后于2013年转投梅赛德斯。这位英国车手在德国制造商效力的12年间又赢得了六个世界冠军。
法拉利在2026年摩纳哥大奖赛前夕宣布查尔斯·勒克莱尔已同意一份新合同，表示他将在“未来几个赛季”留在马拉内罗车队。据信新合同将让他身披红色战袍至少至2028年底，并附带进一步续约的选项。
勒克莱尔曾是法拉利青训车手，2018年租借至索伯完成F1首秀，之后于2019年加入法拉利车手阵容，此后一直是车队常驻成员。
亚历克斯·阿尔本在2026年荷兰大奖赛前与威廉姆斯签下续约合同，效力至2027年底。
这位英泰混血车手于2019年代表红牛二队完成F1首秀，并在赛季中期转投红牛。阿尔本在2020年底被红牛放弃，离开F1一年后于2022年随威廉姆斯重返赛场。
卡洛斯·塞恩斯，威廉姆斯，亚历山大·阿尔本，威廉姆斯
在阿尔本续约宣布一天后，卡洛斯·塞恩斯的未来也在2026年荷兰大奖赛得到确认，与威廉姆斯签下一份多年合同，据信加上合同条款将持续至2028年底。
尽管塞恩斯2015年才完成首秀，但他几乎为半个F1发车阵容效力过，当时他从红牛二队起步，2017年赛季中期转投雷诺。这位西班牙人随后于2019年加入迈凯伦两个赛季，之后转投法拉利四年。塞恩斯于2025年加入威廉姆斯。
与大多数红牛年轻车手一样，利亚姆·劳森一直持一年期合同，2026年也不例外。这位新西兰人在仅作为红牛车手两轮后就被下放至小红牛，但他应对得当，并因此确保了今年在车队的短期未来。
劳森早在2023年就作为丹尼尔·里卡多的伤病替补完成F1首秀，2024年在美国大奖赛起永久接替这位澳大利亚人在小红牛的位置。这导致了他命运不佳的红牛晋升以及随后在2025年重返小红牛。
2026年发车阵容中唯一的F1新秀获得了一份一年合同，以在小红牛证明自己。
这位英国车手在首个赛季迄今表现出色，看起来将在2027年保住发车席位。
关于2027年F1发车阵容，唯一剩下的重大疑问是费尔南多·阿隆索。这位45岁的车手在2024年同意了一份续约合同，将效力至2026赛季末。

阿隆索于2001年代表米纳尔迪完成F1首秀，之后离开赛场一年担任雷诺测试车手，并于2003年回归，开启四年任期，期间赢得两个世界冠军。2007年在迈凯伦的糟糕经历意味着阿隆索于2008年和2009年重返雷诺，直到他加入法拉利五年。在迈凯伦的第二段经历可以说更糟，当时车队正陷入与本田的危机，他于2018年底离开车队和F1。但阿隆索于2021年随阿尔派重返F1（他在恩斯通车队的第三段经历），直到2023年转投阿斯顿·马丁。
兰斯·斯特罗尔处于一个独特的位置，可以说拥有一份无期限合同，因为他的父亲劳伦斯·斯特罗尔拥有车队——所以只要他和父亲愿意，他就可以在阿斯顿·马丁参赛。2024年曾宣布一份“2025年及以后”的合同，至少将他带到2026年底，但预计将无限期延续。
这位加拿大人于2017年代表威廉姆斯完成F1首秀，在车队效力两个赛季后加入赛点，该车队后来于2021年更名为阿斯顿·马丁。
当埃斯特班·奥康于2025年加入哈斯时，这被描述为一份多年合同，据信选项覆盖2027年，但迄今为止车手和车队均未表示同意在本赛季之后继续合作。
奥康于2016年赛季中期作为梅赛德斯青训车手代表马诺完成F1首秀。车队解散后，他加入印度力量，但在2018年底斯特罗尔收购过程中被挤出阵容。在场边一年后，奥康于2020年随雷诺重返F1，一直待到2024年，之后转投哈斯。
奥利弗·贝尔曼于2025年起作为全职F1车手加入哈斯，其当前合同据信将于2026年底到期。
这位英国车手在2024年沙特阿拉伯大奖赛上作为卡洛斯·塞恩斯的替补，意外地为法拉利完成F1首秀。贝尔曼当年又代表哈斯出战两场；阿塞拜疆大奖赛顶替被禁赛的凯文·马格努森，之后又在巴西大奖赛顶替身体不适的丹麦人。贝尔曼随后于2025年成为哈斯正式F1车手。
尼科·霍肯伯格于2025年加入索伯车队，在其向奥迪过渡之前签下一份多年合同，将于2027年底到期。
霍肯伯格丰富多彩的F1生涯始于2010年的威廉姆斯，之后离开一年，2012年在印度力量回归。这位德国人随后于2013年加入索伯，但一年后与印度力量重聚并待到2016年底。在雷诺的两个赛季结束后，这位德国车手在2020年和2021年都未能找到全职席位，但在此期间他为赛点/阿斯顿·马丁五次替补出场。霍肯伯格于2023年随哈斯第二次全职回归，效力两个赛季后加入索伯/奥迪项目。
detailEn: F1 driver contracts: How long is each driver tied down for?
Here is how long each F1 driver contract currently is and when it is due to expire
The details in a Formula 1 driver contract is highly-guarded information, but often the length of the deal is released to the wider world.
Here is how long each F1 driver contract is believed to be and therefore what moves could be possible and when in the future.

The reigning F1 world champion recently announced a new four-year contract with McLaren which will keep him at the team until at least 2030. It is also believed to contain contract clauses which could extend that deal further.
Norris joined McLaren as a junior driver in 2017, stepping up to the F1 team in 2019 and becoming world champion in 2025.
At the start of 2025, Oscar Piastri signed a new deal at McLaren to keep him tied to the team until the end of 2028.
The Australian driver joined McLaren for his F1 debut in 2023 following a hearing with the FIA Contract Recognition Board to settle a dispute between Alpine and McLaren.

Despite Mercedes’ previous pursuit of Max Verstappen, George Russell has been confident of his place at the team with his contract in place. The British driver is signed up to the end of the 2027 season.
Russell joined Mercedes in 2022 following three seasons effectively on loan at Williams where he made his F1 debut in 2019.
Kimi Antonelli is also believed to have a contract at Mercedes that runs until the end of 2027.
The Italian replaced Lewis Hamilton in the Mercedes driver line-up when he left for Ferrari in 2025.
Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, Laurent Mekies, Red Bull Racing Team Principal
Max Verstappen and Red Bull announced a new contract that will run until the end of 2030 at least at the 2026 Dutch GP.
Verstappen, who became a Red Bull junior in 2014, made his F1 debut with sister squad Toro Rosso in 2015 aged just 17 and was promoted to the Red Bull team midway through the 2016 season.
Isack Hadjar’s Red Bull deal is set to expire at the end of 2027, having joined the senior team from Racing Bulls in 2026.
The French driver made his F1 debut in 2025 for Racing Bulls, immediately impressing, highlighted by a podium at the Dutch GP and resulted in his rapid promotion to Red Bull from 2026.

Ferrari has often refrained from revealing the details of contract lengths of its drivers, but all parties have confirmed the deal will run until 2027 at least – meaning, with contract clauses, he signed a three-year deal when he joined back in 2025.

Hamilton made his F1 debut for McLaren in 2007, taking his maiden world title in 2008, before moving to Mercedes in 2013. The British driver won another six world titles with the German manufacturer in his 12 years at the team.

Ferrari announced Charles Leclerc had agreed to a new deal on the eve of the 2026 Monaco GP, stating he was staying at the Maranello squad “for the coming seasons”. It is believed the new deal keeps him in red until at least the end of 2028, with the option of further years.
Leclerc was a Ferrari junior and made his F1 debut on loan at Sauber in 2018 before joining Ferrari’s driver line-up in 2019 where he has remained an ever-present fixture since.
Alex Albon signed a contract extension with Williams ahead of the 2026 Dutch GP to keep him at the team until the end of 2027.

The Anglo-Thai driver made his F1 debut with Toro Rosso in 2019 and made a mid-season switch to Red Bull. Albon was dropped by Red Bull at the end of 2020 and spent one year out of F1 before returning to the grid in 2022 with Williams.
Carlos Sainz, Williams, Alexander Albon, Williams

One day after Albon’s renewal was announced, Carlos Sainz had his future confirmed with a multi-year deal at Williams at the 2026 Dutch GP which is believed to run until the end of 2028 with contract clauses.

Sainz has raced for almost half the F1 grid despite only making his debut in 2015, where he started at Toro Rosso before a midseason switch to Renault in 2017. The Spaniard then joined McLaren in 2019 for two seasons and then on to Ferrari for four years. Sainz joined Williams in 2025.

Like the majority of Red Bull youngsters, Liam Lawson has lived on one-year contracts and 2026 is no different. The Kiwi reacted well to being demoted to Racing Bulls after just two rounds as a Red Bull driver, and duly secured his short-term future at the team for this year.

Lawson made his F1 debut back in 2023 as an injury stand-in for Daniel Ricciardo, and in 2024 he permanently replaced the Australian at Racing Bulls from the United States GP. That led to his ill-fated Red Bull promotion and subsequent return to Racing Bulls in 2025.
F1’s only rookie on the 2026 grid was given a one-year deal to prove himself at Racing Bulls.
The British driver has impressed so far in his debut season and looks set to keep his place on the grid for 2027.
The only major question mark left regarding the 2027 F1 grid is Fernando Alonso. The 45-year-old agreed to a contract extension back in 2024 which will see him to the end of the 2026 season.

Alonso made his F1 debut in 2001 for Minardi before spending one year off the grid as a Renault test driver and duly returning in 2003 for a four-year stint which yielded two world titles. An ill-fated 2007 at McLaren meant Alonso returned to Renault for 2008 and 2009 until he joined Ferrari for five years. A second stint at McLaren arguably was even worse amid its crisis with Honda, and he left both the team and F1 at the end of 2018. But Alonso returned to F1 with Alpine in 2021 (his third stint at the Enstone team) until he switched to Aston Martin from 2023.

Lance Stroll is in the unique position of arguably having a timeless contract given his father Lawrence Stroll owns the team – so he could race at Aston Martin as long as he and his father want him to. Back in 2024, a contract for “2025 and beyond” was announced, at least taking him up to the end of 2026, but it is expected to continue indefinitely.
The Canadian made his F1 debut with Williams in 2017 and spent two seasons at the team before joining Racing Point which was later rebranded as Aston Martin in 2021.

When Esteban Ocon joined Haas from 2025, it was described as a multi-year deal, with options believed to cover 2027, but so far both driver and team haven’t signalled an agreement to go beyond this season.

Ocon made his F1 debut midway through 2016 as a Mercedes junior driving for Manor. After the team folded, he joined Force India but was shuffled out of the line-up as part of the Stroll takeover at the end of 2018. After a year on the sidelines, Ocon returned to F1 in 2020 with Renault where he stayed until 2024 before moving to Haas.
Oliver Bearman joined Haas as a full-time F1 driver from 2025 and his current contract is believed to expire at the end of 2026.

The British driver made a surprise F1 debut for Ferrari as a stand-in for Carlos Sainz at the 2024 Saudi Arabian Grand Prix. Bearman made two further outings that year with Haas; the Azerbaijan GP for the banned Kevin Magnussen and then again for the Dane at the Brazilian GP when he was unwell. Bearman then became a permanent Haas F1 driver in 2025.
Nico Hulkenberg joined the Sauber squad in 2025 ahead of its Audi transition on a multi-year contract which expires at the end of 2027.

Hulkenberg’s colourful F1 career started at Williams in 2010 before a year out, only to return at Force India in 2012. The German then joined Sauber for 2013 but reunited with Force India a year later and stayed until the end of 2016. Two seasons at Renault ended with the German driver not finding a full-time spot for both 2020 and 2021, but he did make five stand-in appearances for Racing Point/Aston Martin in that time. Hulkenberg made his second full-time return in 2023 with Haas where he spent two seasons before joining the Sauber/Audi project.

拉塞尔与梅赛德斯的合同签至2027赛季末，安东内利据信同样至2027年底。
维斯塔潘与红牛在2026年荷兰大奖赛宣布新合同，至少至2030年底。
keyPointsEn: Oscar Piastri signed a new deal at McLaren at the start of 2025, keeping him tied to the team until the end of 2028.
George Russell is signed with Mercedes until the end of the 2027 season, and Kimi Antonelli is also believed to have a contract until the end of 2027.
Max Verstappen and Red Bull announced a new contract at the 2026 Dutch GP that will run until at least the end of 2030.

relatedItems.summaryZh: 丰田否认将于2027年与世界耐力锦标赛车手奥孔签约，称不希望破坏现有车手阵容的和谐。此前哈斯车队官宣将在2026赛季结束后结束与这位30岁法国车手的合作。

relatedItems.originalTitle: Toyota denies 2027 WEC deal with Esteban Ocon
relatedItems.summaryEn: Toyota has denied it will sign Esteban Ocon for the World Endurance Championship in 2027, saying it does not want to jeopardise the harmony within its driver lineups. This follows Haas officially announcing it will end its partnership with the 30-year-old Frenchman at the conclusion of the 2026 season.
detailZh: 丰田否认2027年与奥孔达成WEC协议
这家日本制造商不想破坏其车手阵容内部的和谐
奥孔在F1的选择正逐渐减少，而丰田不会在世界耐力锦标赛（WEC）为他提供席位。
在哈斯车队本周官宣将在2026赛季结束后结束与这位30岁法国车手的合作之后，媒体上关于奥孔职业生涯下一步去向的猜测甚嚣尘上。
随着阿斯顿·马丁确认将继续留用阿隆索和斯特罗尔，凯迪拉克实际上成为奥孔在一级方程式中最后一个现实的选择。
这也正是他还与转投世界耐力锦标赛的可能性联系在一起的原因——可能加盟丰田。但丰田顾问亚历山大·伍尔茨现已向Motorsport.com姊妹刊物Formel1.de的YouTube频道明确表示：“这些传闻毫无根据。”
伍尔茨表示，丰田在勒芒及其世界耐力锦标赛项目上通常会做“相当长远的”规划，目前不打算对现有的六人车手阵容做出任何调整。
“因为当你把三个强势个性放进同一辆赛车时，他们需要时间去彼此接受，去找到正确的调校和正确的合作方式，并达到这样一个阶段：他们不再在内部互相竞争，而是真正激发出彼此的最佳状态。这是一个非常重要的区别，”这位奥地利人解释道。
#8 丰田Gazoo Racing 丰田TR010：塞巴斯蒂安·布耶米、布伦登·哈特利、平川亮
"这是丰田的优势之一：我们拥有这样的车队架构和车队文化，而这种东西不可能一夜之间改变。
"首先，我们签的是长期合同。其次，你不可能随便从外面引进一名车手，直接把他塞进车手阵容里。那样做恰恰有可能破坏我们自2012年以来一直建立并悉心呵护的文化。维护这种文化是我作为顾问、作为与车手密切合作的人的主要职责之一。
他还补充道："但不管你怎么看，这些合同都是长期的，而且我们明年的车手阵容已经百分之百满了。"
丰田目前参加世界耐力锦标赛（WEC），一台车由迈克·康威、尼克·德弗里斯和小林可梦伟驾驶，另一台车由塞巴斯蒂安·布埃米、布伦登·哈特利和平川亮驾驶。这家日本厂商刚刚在家乡富士赛道赢得胜利，在惊心动魄的尾声中，本地英雄平川亮完成了决定胜负的最后一段驾驶。
detailEn: Toyota denies 2027 WEC deal with Esteban Ocon
The Japanese manufacturer doesn't want to jeopardise the harmony within its driver lineups
Esteban Ocon’s Formula 1 options are gradually running out, and Toyota will not provide one in the WEC.

After Haas officially announced this week that it will end its partnership with the 30-year-old Frenchman at the conclusion of the 2026 season, media speculation has been rife over where Ocon’s career might take him next.
With Aston Martin having confirmed that it will continue with Fernando Alonso and Lance Stroll, Cadillac effectively remains Ocon's last realistic option in Formula 1.

That is why he has also been linked with a possible switch to the World Endurance Championship – potentially with Toyota. But Toyota advisor Alexander Wurz has now made it clear to Motorsport.com sister publication Formel1.de’s YouTube channel: "There's nothing to these rumours."
Wurz said that Toyota generally plans "relatively far ahead" when it comes to Le Mans and its WEC programme, and that no changes to its current six-driver line-up are planned.

"Because when you put three alpha personalities in one car, it takes time for them to accept each other, to find the right set-up and the right way of working together, and to reach a point where they don't compete against each other internally but actually bring out the best in one another. That's a very important distinction," the Austrian explained.
#8 Toyota Gazoo Racing Toyota TR010: Sebastien Buemi, Brendon Hartley, Ryo Hirakawa
"That's one of Toyota's strengths: we have this team structure and this team culture, and you can't simply change that overnight.

"First of all, we have long-term contracts. And secondly, you can't just bring in another driver from the outside and slot him into the line-up. That would risk disrupting exactly the culture we've been building and nurturing since 2012. Maintaining that culture is one of my main responsibilities as an advisor and someone who works closely with the drivers.
He added: "But whichever way you look at it, the contracts are long-term and our line-up for next year is 100% full."

Toyota currently competes in the WEC with Mike Conway, Nyck de Vries and Kamui Kobayashi in one car, and Sebastien Buemi, Brendon Hartley and Ryo Hirakawa in the other. The Japanese manufacturer has just won its home race at Fuji, following a thrilling finish with local hero Hirakawa at the wheel for the decisive stint.

relatedItems.originalTitle: Honda secretly introduced second F1 ADUO upgrade in Madrid
relatedItems.summaryEn: Honda Racing Corporation president Koji Watanabe has revealed that Honda introduced its second ADUO (Additional Development and Upgrade Opportunities) upgrade as early as the Spanish Grand Prix, focusing on the power unit's turbocharger.
detailZh: 本田秘密在马德里引入第二个F1 ADUO升级
本田赛车公司（HRC）透露，本田本赛季F1的第二个ADUO升级是新的涡轮增压器，早在西班牙大奖赛就已引入。
本田赛车公司社长渡边浩司透露，本田实际上早在F1西班牙大奖赛就引入了第二个额外开发与升级机会升级，重点针对动力单元的涡轮增压器。
阿斯顿·马丁和本田从赛季开始时表现挣扎，但在亨格罗林引入重大底盘升级后表现略有改善。在赞德沃特，车队还引入了搭载第一个ADUO升级的动力单元。
据测量，本田的内燃机（ICE）比红牛福特动力总成的引擎落后超过4%，后者被评为输出功率最高的引擎，这意味着本田获准在赛季中使用两个空气动力学升级配额令牌。
本田和HRC此前曾解释说，他们只会使用其中一次ADUO机会。“我们两次都用了，”渡边在接受Motorsport.com网站采访时透露，当时他被问到为什么本田决定只使用一次ADUO升级。
“我们在荷兰引入了第一次ADUO升级，然后在西班牙大奖赛上，我们把一套包含第二次升级的动力单元装到了斯特罗尔的车上。
“我们在荷兰引入的2号规格动力单元存在一些可驾驶性问题，所以我们在西班牙大奖赛上引入了一个改进版的涡轮增压器。”
事实上，国际汽联的动力单元部件使用清单显示，斯特罗尔的赛车在西班牙大奖赛时已经用上了本赛季的第五个涡轮增压器。费尔南多·阿隆索的赛车也在阿塞拜疆大奖赛装上了第五个涡轮增压器，而这看起来就是升级版本。
当被问及目标是否是解决涡轮迟滞问题时，渡边回答说：“是的。”他随后解释了分阶段引入升级部件的思路。
“如果我们能一次性把所有东西都引入当然更好，但首先在荷兰引入规格2（Spec 2）非常重要。与此同时，我们也在研究解决涡轮迟滞的对策，所以在西班牙引入了这部分。
“因此，应用最终被分成了两部分。”
不过渡边也表示，本田仍未完全发挥其动力单元的全部潜力。
本田此前为红牛供应引擎时，不被允许引入性能升级，但仍继续利用模拟来确定动力单元的运行极限，并逐年逐步提高这些极限。这就是本田所说的“可靠性研发”。
例如，红牛在2024年采用了极其窄小的侧箱，同时也缩小了用于引入冷却气流的开口尺寸。这也得益于提高动力单元的运行极限才得以实现。
“就ADUO而言，我们已经用完了本赛季的升级机会。从这里开始，我们将继续在不涉及硬件的方面下功夫，同时也进行面向未来发展的研发。”渡边说道。
我认为我们距离完全发挥这套动力单元的全部性能还很远。我相信它的竞争力仍有提升空间。
此前仍有一些地方存在动力不足，因此我们带着明确的目标数值开发了第二版规格。我们已经达成了这些目标，所以在赛季剩余的时间里，我们的重点将放在充分利用现有成果上，而不是继续开发硬件。
即便如此，我们仍要确保自己能够真正地进行竞争。
detailEn: Honda secretly introduced second F1 ADUO upgrade in Madrid
Honda's second ADUO upgrade of the F1 season was a new turbocharger, already introduced at the Spanish Grand Prix, HRC reveals

Honda Racing Corporation president Koji Watanabe has revealed that Honda actually introduced its second ADUO (Additional Development and Upgrade Opportunities) upgrade as early as Formula 1’s Spanish Grand Prix, with the upgrade focused on the power unit's turbocharger.

Aston Martin and Honda struggled from the start of the season, but their performance slightly improved after a major chassis upgrade was introduced at the Hungaroring. In Zandvoort, the team also introduced a power unit fitted with the first ADUO upgrade.

Honda's ICE was measured to be more than 4% behind the Red Bull Ford Powertrains engine, which was rated as having the highest output, meaning Honda was granted permission to use two ADUO tokens during the season.

Honda and HRC had previously explained that they would use only one of those ADUO opportunities. “We used both of them,” Watanabe revealed to Motorsport.com when asked why Honda had decided to use only one ADUO upgrade.
“We introduced the first ADUO upgrade in the Netherlands, and then we put a PU incorporating the second update into Lance Stroll's car at the Spanish Grand Prix.
“The Spec 2 PU we introduced in the Netherlands had some drivability issues, so we introduced an improved turbo at the Spanish Grand Prix.”

Indeed, the FIA's list of PU component usage shows that Stroll's car was fitted with its fifth turbocharger of the season at the Spanish GP. Fernando Alonso's car was also fitted with his fifth turbo, which would appear to be the upgraded version, at the Azerbaijan GP.
Asked whether the objective was to address turbo lag, Watanabe replied: “Yes.” He subsequently explained the thinking behind the staggered introduction of the upgrades.

“It would have been better if we could have introduced everything at once, but it was important to introduce Spec 2 in the Netherlands first. We were also working on measures to address the turbo lag in parallel, so we introduced that in Spain.
“So the application ended up being split between the two.”
Watanabe also said, however, that Honda is still not extracting the full potential of its power unit.

When Honda was previously supplying Red Bull, it was not allowed to introduce performance upgrades, but it continued to use simulations to determine the operating limits of the PU and gradually raise those limits year after year. This was what Honda referred to as “reliability development”.

For example, Red Bull adopted extremely small sidepods in 2024, while also reducing the size of the openings used to draw in airflow for cooling. This was also made possible by raising the PU's operating limits.

“As far as ADUO is concerned, we have used up our opportunities for this season. From here, we will continue working on things that don't involve hardware, as well as developments that will lead into the future”, Watanabe said.
“I don't think we are anywhere near extracting the full performance of the PU. I believe there is still room to improve its competitiveness.

“There were still areas where we were lacking power, so we developed Spec 2 with target figures in mind. We have achieved those targets, so for the remainder of the season, our focus will be on making full use of what we have, rather than continuing to develop the hardware.
“Even so, we want to make sure we are able to fight properly.”

在赞德沃特，车队还引入了搭载第一个ADUO升级的动力单元。
渡边浩司是本田赛车公司的社长。
keyPointsEn: Aston Martin and Honda struggled from the start of the season, but performance slightly improved after a major chassis upgrade at the Hungaroring.
In Zandvoort, the team also introduced a power unit fitted with the first ADUO upgrade.

Horner told The Times that working with Ferrari would be "the dream" and the only team where he would accept a non-ownership role at this stage of his career.
detailZh: 京特·施泰纳调侃克里斯蒂安·霍纳与法拉利的传闻是给书做宣传
京特·施泰纳否认了克里斯蒂安·霍纳与弗雷德·瓦塞尔在法拉利共事的可能性
前哈斯一级方程式车队领队京特·施泰纳认为克里斯蒂安·霍纳和弗雷德·瓦塞尔在法拉利并肩工作的可能性不大。
关于霍纳未来去向的猜测在其接受《泰晤士报》采访后升温。霍纳表示他愿意考虑在马拉内罗车队担任领导职务。霍纳称与法拉利合作是"梦想"，并表示在他职业生涯的这个阶段，法拉利是他唯一愿意接受非所有者职位的车队。
在《红旗播客》节目中，施泰纳表示，霍纳只是在调整自己的策略，以求重返争冠行列，还打趣说他可能是想为自己的新书做些宣传。
“我认为克里斯蒂安想回到一级方程式，而且他说得很清楚，他不想再为任何人打工了。显然，他的A计划行不通，于是他就转向B计划，而如果他去了法拉利工作，就拿不到那里的股份，”施泰纳说。“我认为他想进去，并且他在那里看到了一个机会。”
他补充道：“另外，这对他来说也没有什么坏处。他要出一本书，这会有助于那本书的销售，或者也许没帮助，我们不知道，但至少算是有一点宣传。”
施泰纳还回应了关于霍纳与瓦塞尔在法拉利共事的问题，并否定了这种可能性。
"我认为弗雷德留在那里为克里斯蒂安工作的情况不会发生,"他说。"弗雷德本人是一个非常成功的人。但首先,我不知道弗雷德是否想离开,或者他是否不得不离开。
"说到底,弗雷德手上有一份合同,而在一级方程式里这些合同又值多少钱呢?我猜并不多,但那里没有容纳他们两个人的空间。这就是我的看法。那种情况不会发生。"
detailEn: Guenther Steiner jokes Christian Horner Ferrari talk is good book publicity
Guenther Steiner has dismissed the prospect of Christian Horner and Fred Vasseur working together at Ferrari
Former Haas Formula 1 team principal Guenther Steiner has dismissed the possibility of Christian Horner and Fred Vasseur working alongside each other at Ferrari.

Speculation regarding Horner's future intensified after he told The Times he would consider a leadership role at the Maranello outfit. Horner described working with Ferrari as "the dream" and indicated it is the only team at which he would accept a non-ownership position at this stage of his career.
Speaking on The Red Flags Podcast, Steiner suggested Horner is simply adapting his strategy to return to the championship and joked that he could be getting some publicity for his new book.

"I think Christian wants to come back to Formula 1, and he said clearly that he doesn't want to work for anybody anymore. Obviously, plan A for him doesn't work out, so he goes to plan B and he doesn't get a stake in Ferrari if he goes to work there," Steiner said. "I think he wants to come in and he sees an opportunity there."

He added: "The other thing, there's nothing bad for him in it as well. He's releasing a book so it will help the sale of that one, or maybe not, we don't know, but at least it's a little bit of publicity."
Steiner also addressed questions about Horner and Vasseur working together at Ferrari and dismissed the possibility.

"I don't think that's going to happen that Fred is staying there working for Christian," he said. "Fred in himself is a very successful guy. But first of all, I don't know that Fred wants to leave or that he has to leave.
"In the end, Fred has got a contract and how much are they worth in Formula 1? Not a lot, I guess, but there is not space for the two of them. That's my opinion on it. That is not going to happen."

Horner described working with Ferrari as "the dream" and the only team at which he would accept a non-ownership position at this stage of his career.
